title: What you can tell about Ai programming for a game development?
author: Adam_Taylar
selftext:
Hey I'm new to unreal engine and working with  a small project, C++ programming is the most hardest part to me. I would like to know, Would it be very useful for me to use an AI tool for learning and understanding cpp?

I'm still a student for this industry. I'm learning game develop mechanics and programming. Most of things actually I learned from YouTube and self learned.

comments.author: Apprehensive_Oil1475
comments.body:
It's not just helpful, it's essential. 
As a computer engineer with 5 years in the industry in an international tech company, I can tell you its an absolute MUST to master AI augmented software development in general, not even specifically in UE (it helps a ton there as well). Coding with AI, agentic workflows, learning how to co-work and do code review with and to coding agents is absolutely essential. Specifically for game dev, and as a beginner in UE, you can use it to both create and iterate on systems very quickly, and learn the fundamentals with the agent, while building in tandem. It's such a fun experience. Best of luck!

comments.author: Ok-File-2759
comments.body: You can definitely use AI to teach you how to code. You can use it to teach you pretty much anything. I’m in my senior year of a computer science degree, and I’d definitely say I’ve learned way more from ChatGPT than any of my professors. But even then, I just use codex to write up thousands of lines of working code in less than an hour

comments.author: EC36339
comments.body: As a C++ developer with decades of experience: Yes, it would. Even I have learned new things just by looking at code produced by LLMs. Ignore the haters. If you know how to learn things, you'll be fine, and LLMs will only make you more powerful.

replies.body:
